# Discovery Lab

> Learn it by doing it. Free, hands-on interactive simulations in science, computing and languages for primary and secondary students, each with a built-in auto-marked check and a downloadable evidence report. Bilingual (English and Spanish), designed for dyslexia, dyspraxia and other special educational needs, and built by an independent educator (Diego Urrutia Guevara). Student work never leaves the browser.

Part of MoreHuman Ed: https://morehumaned.com/
